headline: Argentine Court Declares Export Tax Decree Unconstitutional for Aceitera General Deheza
summary: An Argentine federal appeals court declared unconstitutional a decree by former President Alberto Fernández that raised soybean subproduct export duties from 31% to 33%, ordering a refund for Aceitera General Deheza.
why: Judicial rulings on agricultural export tariffs affect corporate tax liabilities and profit margins for major agribusiness exporters.

impacts.name: Argentina
impacts.why: Court rulings invalidating export levies reduce tax burdens for agricultural processors.
